description: Create an identity-only agent: an Agentboxd identity that signs in to apps with get_identity_token but has NO mailbox (it cannot send or receive email). Use it when you only need to log in to apps, not an email address. Pass client_id (any stable string) to make it idempotent. Returns id (use as inbox_id in get_identity_token) and a handle (not an email address).

client_id.description: Your own idempotency key for this identity.

display_name.description: Name shown to apps (the "name" claim), e.g. "Research Agent".

username.description: The handle (before @). Omit for a random readable one.

name: create_identity
title: Create identity (no mailbox)
